title: %rate — interest rate per period
purpose: Solve for the per-period rate given the number of periods, payment, present value, and future value.
notes: Solved by Newton–Raphson; the result is the per-period rate as a fraction (about 2.92% here).
Sign convention: an inflow (pv) is positive and the offsetting payments are negative.
Argument order is nper, pmt, pv, fv.

avoid.why: %rate requires all four arguments; fewer than four yields ~ (null)
